devdoc.author: Pantherprotocol Contributors
devdoc.details: This contract aggregates reward calculations from multiple sources including FeeMaster,      ZkpReserveController, and PayMaster to provide total estimated rewards

params.estimatedZkpBalance: Total ZKP balance to calculate from

returns._0: Amount of ZKPs allocated for PRP converter

params.zAssets: Array of zAsset addresses to calculate rewards for

returns.zkpsToBeSendToPrpConverter: Total ZKP tokens to be sent to PRP converter

params.rewardIssuer: Address of the contract issuing the reward
params.voucherType: Type of voucher to get reward amount for

devdoc.title: PrpRewardEstimator

calculateDistributionPrpRewards(uint256).notice: Calculates PRP rewards from ZKP distribution

calculatePrpConverterZkpShare(uint256).notice: Calculates the amount of ZKPs to be sent to PRP converter

estimateTotalPrpRewardsAndReleasableZkps.notice: Estimates total PRP rewards and ZKP tokens to be sent to PRP converter

getVoucherRewardAmount(address,bytes4).notice: Gets the reward amount from a voucher

userdoc.notice: Helper contract to estimate PRP rewards and ZKP distributions across various protocol components
